maintenance_led.reason: Mainly manufactures pre-insulated piping systems for new district energy, industrial and mining projects; project-based new installations, not repair or replacement.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly industrial, energy, mining and commercial district-energy project owners and contractors, not primarily government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own engineered pipe products and services; no evidence of regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Engineered pre-insulated piping and leak detection are specified into projects; switching needs requalification, and failure risks safety or hazardous-chemical containment.

notes: Government-owned district energy customers may exist, but the mix is not shown on the site.
